result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for the Anna/Bob example or run it separately.

In `DataStore.java`, I added a `CustomerAttributedRecords.ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant. It is the same as `PURCHASE_ORDERS` but with `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` now uses it. Sorting and the zero-count rows for reps with no purchase orders are unchanged.

The per-country purchase-order report shares the old `PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant, so I left it counting cancelled orders, since you only asked about the per-rep report. If you want the per-country report to skip them too, it's a one-line switch to `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS`. I'd then drop the old constant, since nothing would use it.
